name: Ogryns
summary: Ogryns may only take the Ogryn Skullbreaker class. They cannot be Veterans, Zealots, Psykers, Arbites, Hive Scum, Skitarii, or Ratling Sharpshooters. Ogryn variety comes from Ogryn subclasses, not from normal class choice.
